requirements.quote:
The list of supported symmetric encryption algorithms has been
      pruned of all algorithms that are considered legacy.  Those that
      remain are all Authenticated Encryption with Associated Data
      (AEAD) algorithms.
requirements.condition: when selecting a TLS 1.3 symmetric encryption algorithm
requirements.forbidden_behavior: select a legacy or non-AEAD symmetric encryption algorithm
requirements.why_checkable: The TLS 1.3 algorithm registry and negotiation paths can be checked for non-AEAD selections.

requirements.quote:
The cipher suite concept has been changed to
      separate the authentication and key exchange mechanisms from the
      record protection algorithm (including secret key length) and a
      hash to be used with both the key derivation function and
      handshake message authentication code (MAC).
requirements.condition: when representing or negotiating a TLS 1.3 cipher suite
requirements.required_behavior: separate authentication and key exchange mechanisms from the cipher suite's record-protection and hash selection
requirements.forbidden_behavior: derive the authentication or key exchange mechanism from the TLS 1.3 cipher suite identifier
requirements.why_checkable: Cipher-suite parsing and negotiation state can be inspected for forbidden authentication or key-exchange coupling.

requirements.quote:
The cipher suite concept has been changed to
      separate the authentication and key exchange mechanisms from the
      record protection algorithm (including secret key length) and a
      hash to be used with both the key derivation function and
      handshake message authentication code (MAC).
requirements.condition: when a TLS 1.3 cipher suite is selected
requirements.required_behavior: obtain the record-protection algorithm and its secret key length from the cipher suite
requirements.why_checkable: The selected cipher suite can be mapped to the configured AEAD algorithm and key length.

requirements.quote:
The cipher suite concept has been changed to
      separate the authentication and key exchange mechanisms from the
      record protection algorithm (including secret key length) and a
      hash to be used with both the key derivation function and
      handshake message authentication code (MAC).
requirements.condition: when a TLS 1.3 cipher suite is selected
requirements.required_behavior: use the cipher suite's hash for both the key derivation function and the handshake message MAC
requirements.forbidden_behavior: use inconsistent cipher-suite hashes for key derivation and handshake message authentication
requirements.why_checkable: Key-schedule and handshake-MAC configuration can be compared with the selected cipher-suite hash.

requirements.quote: Static RSA and Diffie-Hellman cipher suites have been removed;
requirements.condition: when negotiating a TLS 1.3 cipher suite
requirements.forbidden_behavior: negotiate a static RSA cipher suite
requirements.why_checkable: TLS 1.3 cipher-suite offers and selections can be checked for static RSA suites.

requirements.quote: Static RSA and Diffie-Hellman cipher suites have been removed;
requirements.condition: when negotiating a TLS 1.3 cipher suite
requirements.forbidden_behavior: negotiate a static Diffie-Hellman cipher suite
requirements.why_checkable: TLS 1.3 cipher-suite offers and selections can be checked for static Diffie-Hellman suites.

requirements.quote:
all
      public-key based key exchange mechanisms now provide forward
      secrecy.
requirements.condition: when TLS 1.3 uses a public-key-based key exchange mechanism
requirements.forbidden_behavior: use a public-key key exchange that lacks forward secrecy
requirements.why_checkable: Negotiated public-key exchanges can be checked for ephemeral key agreement and absence of static key transport.

requirements.quote: All handshake messages after the ServerHello are now encrypted.
requirements.condition: for a TLS 1.3 handshake message sent after ServerHello
requirements.forbidden_behavior: send the handshake message in plaintext
requirements.why_checkable: A handshake trace can verify record protection for every post-ServerHello handshake message.

requirements.quote:
The HMAC-based Extract-and-Expand Key
      Derivation Function (HKDF) is used as an underlying primitive.
requirements.condition: when performing the TLS 1.3 key derivation functions
requirements.required_behavior: use HKDF as the underlying primitive
requirements.why_checkable: The key-schedule implementation and test vectors can verify HKDF use.

requirements.quote:
The handshake state machine has been significantly restructured to
      be more consistent and to remove superfluous messages such as
      ChangeCipherSpec (except when needed for middlebox compatibility).
requirements.condition: when middlebox compatibility does not require ChangeCipherSpec
requirements.forbidden_behavior: include a ChangeCipherSpec message as part of the TLS 1.3 handshake state machine
requirements.why_checkable: Handshake traces can distinguish compatibility ChangeCipherSpec records from state-machine messages.

requirements.quote:
TLS 1.3
      removed point format negotiation in favor of a single point format
      for each curve.
requirements.condition: when using an elliptic curve in TLS 1.3
requirements.required_behavior: use the single point format defined for that curve
requirements.why_checkable: Extension handling and encoded key shares can be checked for absence of point-format negotiation and use of the curve's fixed format.

requirements.quote:
Other cryptographic improvements were made, including changing the
      RSA padding to use the RSA Probabilistic Signature Scheme
      (RSASSA-PSS),
requirements.condition: when TLS 1.3 uses an RSA signature
requirements.forbidden_behavior: use a removed RSA signature padding mode
requirements.why_checkable: Signature-scheme selection and generated signatures can be checked for RSASSA-PSS.

requirements.quote:
the removal of compression, the Digital
      Signature Algorithm (DSA), and custom Ephemeral Diffie-Hellman
      (DHE) groups.
requirements.why_checkable: TLS 1.3 negotiation and record configuration can be checked for compression.

requirements.quote:
the removal of compression, the Digital
      Signature Algorithm (DSA), and custom Ephemeral Diffie-Hellman
      (DHE) groups.
requirements.condition: when selecting a TLS 1.3 signature algorithm
requirements.why_checkable: Signature algorithm offers, selections, and verification dispatch can be checked for DSA.

requirements.quote:
the removal of compression, the Digital
      Signature Algorithm (DSA), and custom Ephemeral Diffie-Hellman
      (DHE) groups.
requirements.condition: when selecting a TLS 1.3 finite-field Diffie-Hellman group
requirements.why_checkable: Supported-group parsing and key-exchange setup can be checked for non-standard custom DHE parameters.

requirements.quote:
The TLS 1.2 version negotiation mechanism has been deprecated in
      favor of a version list in an extension.
requirements.condition: when negotiating a TLS 1.3 protocol version
requirements.required_behavior: use the version list carried in an extension
requirements.forbidden_behavior: use the deprecated TLS 1.2 version negotiation mechanism as the TLS 1.3 negotiation mechanism
requirements.why_checkable: ClientHello construction and version selection can be checked for extension-based version negotiation.

requirements.quote:
Session resumption with and without server-side state as well as
      the PSK-based cipher suites of earlier TLS versions have been
      replaced by a single new PSK exchange.
requirements.condition: when TLS 1.3 performs session resumption or a PSK-based exchange
requirements.forbidden_behavior: use an earlier-version resumption mechanism or PSK-based cipher suite as the TLS 1.3 exchange
requirements.why_checkable: Resumption and PSK handshake paths can be checked for use of the unified TLS 1.3 PSK exchange.
